newsitem.title: USA: SunAmerica Inc files for shelf offering.
newsitem.headline: SunAmerica Inc files for shelf offering.

text.p: SunAmerica Inc said it filed a universal shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to offerings of unsecured debt, preferred stock or common stock.

The company said the offerings may be made from time to time, but that the aggregate initial public offering price of all the securities covered by the filing shall not exceed $1.75 billion. It said this registration replaces the company's existing shelf registration, of which about $519 million is currently available for use.
